name: queue_drift
plan: Measure: of the live queue items (not done or parked) that worker/classify.py has judged, the share with already_done >= 0.5. Rule, fixed before the run: holds if that share is at least 0.15 (status drift is a material lever, as Claude's first reading of 54 untyped items suggested: about 12); fails if under 0.15; invalid if fewer than 20 items have been judged.
